The *Nibbānasukhajānanapañha* ("The Question on the Happiness of Extinguishment") is a section of the *Milindapañha* (Mil 3.4.10). It is cataloged within the late Sutta collections of the Pali tradition. The text has been translated into multiple languages, including an English translation by John Kelly.

A full parallel to the discourse is preserved in the Chinese translation of the Milinda tradition, cataloged at T 1670b 2.44 under the title "On Nirvana as Happiness". In automated text-reuse analysis conducted by DharmaNexus, the text shares 29 internal Pali matching passages across three other sections of the *Milindapañha*, though no cross-language matches with a score of 10 or higher are recorded [DharmaNexus]. Its most extensive Pali-internal overlap occurs with *Nibbānarūpasaṇṭhānapañha* (Mil 6.3.10; 21 matches), alongside shared passages with the immediately preceding *Nibbānalabhanapañha* (Mil 3.4.9; 5 matches) and *Buddhassaanuttarabhāvajānanapañha* (Mil 3.5.3; 3 matches) [DharmaNexus].
